fields.description: Baccarat Residences Saadiyat is Aldar’s branded collection in Saadiyat Grove, within Abu Dhabi’s Saadiyat Cultural District. The original release comprises 77 homes across two buildings, including two and three bedroom residences, four bedroom sky villas and two signature penthouses. Sou Fujimoto Architects designed the buildings, with interiors by StudioPCH.

reviewCoverage.identity: Original Aldar Saadiyat release confirmed by February 2026 developer announcement; unrelated H&H Baccarat Dubai material excluded.
reviewCoverage.location: Saadiyat Grove within Saadiyat Cultural District confirmed, with the existing Saadiyat Island area ID.
reviewCoverage.residences: Official launch confirms 2/3-bedroom homes, 4-bedroom sky villas and two signature penthouses. Penthouse bedroom count not independently confirmed.
reviewCoverage.areas: Two complete branded Type A plans visually inspected. They lack whole-home area schedules; no measurement inferred from illustrations or broad portal ranges.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Official project and service pages reviewed. Optional personal services carry additional fees and are separated from facilities.
reviewCoverage.pricing: AED 16m two-bedroom launch guide corroborated by Property Finder and Golden Dome, without presenting it as a live allocation.
reviewCoverage.payment: 10/60/30 corroborated across two project-specific portals; official landing does not publish instalment dates.
reviewCoverage.handover: Q3 2029 corroborated by Property Finder and Golden Dome. No project-specific signed delivery date obtained.
reviewCoverage.documents: Official launch PDF downloaded and two-page branded apartment-plan collection visually checked. A complete public official sales brochure was not located, so brochure URL remains null.

overview: The architecture uses curved terraces and layered glazing to respond to the island’s shoreline. StudioPCH’s interiors offer light and dark finish directions, while selected residences have customization options. Compare the particular home’s finish schedule and view orientation; the collection’s overall design description does not establish either for every unit.
research.locationNote: The development is within Saadiyat Grove in Saadiyat Cultural District, close to the museum district and Mamsha Al Saadiyat. Ask for the apartment’s orientation and actual outlook rather than assuming every room has the same sea or museum view.
research.priceNote: Property Finder and Golden Dome publish a starting guide of AED 16m. This is a historical collection reference, not confirmation of an available apartment, a penthouse quotation or a reserved price.
research.paymentNote: The published reference allocation is 10% booking, 60% during construction and 30% at handover. Confirm dates and any remaining balance for the selected home; management charges and transaction costs are separate.
research.handoverNote: Project-specific portal references agree on Q3 2029; Property Finder specifies September 2029. Treat this as an estimate until Aldar confirms the selected residence’s current contract schedule.
